age.evidence: We therefore examined whether chronic psilocin microdosing alters behavior and dentate gyrus (DG) cell proliferation in adult male Wistar rats... Rats weighed 250 to 300 g at the start of behavioral testing.

sex.evidence: Male Wistar rats (N = 30 for behavioral tasks and N = 14 for immunohistochemistry, Velaz, Czech Republic)

dosing.evidence: Psilocin or saline was administered subcutaneously at doses of 0.05 mg/kg and 0.075 mg/kg, in a volume of 2 ml/kg (n = 10 per group). Psilocin was... freshly prepared in 0.9% NaCl with glacial acetic acid (5 μl/20 ml). Rats received six alternating doses of psilocin or saline over an 18-day period... Microdosing continued... for a total duration of five weeks.

handling.evidence: No handling protocol described; only 'Before giving any treatment or handling the animals, each rat was placed in a clean cage...'

group_housing.evidence: Male Wistar rats... were kept in pairs in a 12:12 h light/dark cycle. (Note: for the SIT, 'Thirty experimental rats were housed individually for four days prior to testing' and then returned to cage-mates.)

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12:12 h light/dark cycle... All dosing and testing took place during the light phase.

assays.assay_description: EPM with two open and two closed arms (50 x 10 cm; 40 cm closed-arm walls); 5-min free exploration 48 h after last microdose; measured open-arm time, open-arm entry frequency and latency, total distance, rearing, head dips, stretch-attend postures.

application_type.evidence: Psilocin or saline was administered subcutaneously

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room habituation reported: 'Prior to testing, animals were habituated to the testing environment for approximately one hour.'

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to explore the arena freely for five minutes

food_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM apparatus; no food in apparatus (home cage diet ad libitum).

water_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM apparatus; no water in apparatus (home cage water ad libitum).

time_to_assay.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

sample_size.evidence: N = 30 for behavioral tasks; n = 10 per group

outcomes.summary: The higher psilocin microdose (0.075 mg/kg) significantly increased latency to first open-arm entry vs. control and 0.05 mg/kg, interpreted as a subtle anxiogenic effect. No effects on open-arm time, open-arm entries, distance, rearing, head dips or stretch-attend.
outcomes.evidence: rats treated with the higher psilocin dose (0.075 mg/kg) showed a significantly longer latency to enter the open arm compared to both the control group (p = 0.0045) and the 0.05 mg/ kg group (p = 0.0119)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Variables included duration of open-arm entries, latency and frequency of open-arm entries, distance traveled (cm), frequency of rears..., head-dips..., and stretch-attend postures

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Session totals only; no within-session time course reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: frequency of rears (vertical stretching with forelimbs off the floor), head-dips (snout below edge level), and stretch-attend postures (elongated, cautious movements)

B5_social.evidence: Individual anxiety test; no social component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed using EthoVision XT 12.1 and The Observer XT 11

B8_multivariate.evidence: Each variable analysed separately by one-way ANCOVA.

E1_environment_type.evidence: consisted of two opposing open arms and two opposing closed arms, each 50 cm long and 10 cm wide

E2_shelter.evidence: definitionally absent: EPM closed arms are not a shelter per rubric

E3_bedding.evidence: definitionally absent: EPM has no bedding

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in EPM.

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM scored as single open space per rubric.

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were placed in the central square... and allowed to explore the arena freely

D1_continuity.evidence: allowed to explore the arena freely for five minutes

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single EPM test within the battery.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug EPM recording; pre-drug HCNT used a different apparatus.

D5_followup.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

application_type.evidence: Psilocin or saline was administered subcutaneously

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room habituation reported: 'habituated to the testing environment for approximately one hour.'

setup_restrain.evidence: each rat was allowed to explore the apparatus for 15 min on two consecutive days

time_to_assay.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

sample_size.evidence: N = 30 for behavioral tasks; n = 10 per group

outcomes.summary: Psilocin microdosing did not significantly affect novelty-seeking in the HBT; the change in head dips across sessions showed a non-significant trend (p=0.075) and rearing was unaffected.
outcomes.evidence: For change in head dips duration in HBT, the main effect of group approached significance, F(2, 25) =2.88, p =0.075... HBT rearing frequency did not show any significant effects (F(2, 25) = 1.36, p = 0.275 for group

B1_num_measures.evidence: Measured variables included the change in head-dip frequency... between the two sessions, as well as rearing frequency during the second session.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Head-dip change is a between-session comparison.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-dipping and rearing are well-established indices of motivational exploration

B6_cognitive.evidence: Exploratory/novelty-seeking test, not framed as learning/memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed using EthoVision XT 12.1 and The Observer XT 11

E1_environment_type.evidence: square black plastic arena measuring 80 × 80 × 40 cm, featuring an elevated floor insert with four 4-cm holes

E3_bedding.evidence: Plastic arena with floor insert; no bedding described.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Marbles in holes are test stimuli: 'Two of the holes, positioned diagonally, contained familiar objects (e.g., glass marbles).'

E7_social_context.evidence: each rat was allowed to explore the apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: each rat was allowed to explore the apparatus for 15 min on two consecutive days

D5_followup.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

assays.assay_description: 80 x 80 x 40 cm black plastic arena, virtual 5x5 grid; 5-min free exploration; measured total distance and thigmotaxis.

application_type.evidence: Psilocin or saline was administered subcutaneously

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room habituation reported; OFT described as 'a novel arena'.

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to explore freely for five minutes

food_restriction.evidence: No food in open field arena.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in open field arena.

time_to_assay.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

outcomes.summary: Psilocin microdosing did not alter total distance moved or thigmotaxis in the OFT.
outcomes.evidence: For distance moved in the OFT, there was no significant effect of group, F(2, 26) = 0.36, p = 0.702... For thigmotaxis in the OFT, there was no significant effect of treatment group, F(2, 26) = 1.17, p = 0.325

assays.assay_description: Experimental rat (isolated 4 days) paired with unfamiliar weight-matched vehicle-treated conspecific in the 80 x 80 x 40 cm OFT arena; free interaction recorded 15 min; measured prosocial contact (pouncing, pinning, chasing) and social investigation (sniffing).

application_type.evidence: Psilocin or saline was administered subcutaneously

setup_habituation.evidence: Only stimulus conspecifics were 'pre-exposed to the testing arena for 30 min'; no apparatus habituation reported for experimental rats beyond prior OFT exposure.

setup_restrain.evidence: Each pair was placed in the center of the arena, and their social behavior was recorded for 15 min.

time_to_assay.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

sample_size.evidence: 30 pairs in total: 10 vehicle-vehicle pairs, 10 psilocin 0.05 mg/kg-vehicle pairs, and 10 psilocin 0.075 mg/kg-vehicle pairs

outcomes.summary: Psilocin microdosing did not significantly alter prosocial contact or social investigation.
outcomes.statistics: Prosocial contact F(2,25)=0.80, p=0.463; social investigation F(2,26)=0.21, p=0.810
outcomes.evidence: For prosocial contact, neither the group effect (F(2, 25) = 0.80, p = 0.463)... Similarly, for social investigation, no significant effects of group (F(2, 26) =0.21, p =0.810)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Dependent variables included the duration of pro-social contact (sum of pouncing, pinning, and chasing) and social investigation (e.g., sniffing the partner).

B4_ethological.evidence: pouncing, pinning, and chasing... sniffing the partner

B5_social.evidence: Each pair was placed in the center of the arena, and their social behavior was recorded for 15 min.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed using EthoVision XT 12.1 and The Observer XT 11

E1_environment_type.evidence: conducted in the same square black plastic arena used for the OFT (80 ×80 ×40 cm)

E7_social_context.evidence: Each pair was placed in the center of the arena, and their social behavior was recorded for 15 min.

D1_continuity.evidence: their social behavior was recorded for 15 min

D5_followup.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

assays.assay_description: Glass cylinders (21 cm diameter, 46 cm high), water 23-25 °C, 30 cm depth; 15-min unrecorded habituation swim on day 1 and 5-min recorded test on day 2; active escape-like swimming (pixel-motion analysis) and latency to behavioural disengagement.

application_type.evidence: Psilocin or saline was administered subcutaneously

setup_habituation.evidence: a 15-min habituation phase on the first day, followed by a five-minute test session on the second day

setup_restrain.evidence: transparent cylindrical glass tanks... filled with water (FST cylinder counts as restraint per rubric)

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water accessible in FST cylinder.

time_to_assay.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

sample_size.evidence: N = 30 for behavioral tasks; n = 10 per group

outcomes.summary: Psilocin microdosing did not affect latency to behavioural disengagement or active swimming; baseline (HCNT) locomotion significantly predicted active swimming.
outcomes.statistics: Latency F(2,26)=0.29, p=0.748; active swimming F(2,26)=0.25, p=0.783; covariate for swimming F(1,26)=5.50, p=0.027
outcomes.evidence: For latency to behavioral disengagement in the FST, no significant group effect was found, F(2, 26) = 0.29, p = 0.748... for the level of active swimming in FST, the group effect remained non-significant, F(2, 26) = 0.25, p = 0.783

B1_num_measures.evidence: Two dependent variables were measured: active escape-like swimming and latency to behavioral disengagement.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Latency is a single derived value; no binned time course reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: FST swimming/disengagement not ethological per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Active swimming was quantified using pixel motion analysis with an in-house Python script — motion-energy measure, not a behavioural-state classifier.

E1_environment_type.evidence: transparent cylindrical glass tanks (21 cm in diameter, 46 cm in height)

D1_continuity.evidence: a 15-min habituation phase on the first day, followed by a five-minute test session on the second day, during which behavioral data were recorded

D3_recording_days.evidence: Behavioural data recorded only on day 2 test session.

D5_followup.evidence: All behavioral testing sessions were conducted 48 h after the preceding dose.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same five assays (EPM, HBT, OFT, SIT, mFST); no merging needed. The Home-Cage Novelty Pre-test was excluded as an assay because it was run before any psilocin administration (used only as an ANCOVA covariate); it is in a different apparatus so does not count as D4 baseline for other assays. BrdU/Ki-67 immunohistochemistry excluded (non-behavioural).
time_to_assay overridden to short_term_1to7d for all assays (48 h = 2880 min exceeds the 2-24 h bin); followed deepseek4.

mFST D1/D3 overridden to single session/1 day (deepseek4) despite 2/3 candidates scoring multiple: paper states behavioural data were recorded only during the day-2 5-min test, the day-1 15-min swim was habituation.
D5_followup = 1 for all assays (modal; testing 48 h after last dose satisfies >=24 h).
setup_habituation = not_reported for EPM/HBT/OFT/SIT (modal): the 1-h habituation was to the testing room, not the apparatus; mFST = yes (day-1 pre-swim).
EPM B1 value corrected to '7+' (7 measures; gemma's '4-6' label inconsistent with its score of 3).
mFST B7 = 0 (modal): in-house pixel-motion activity metric is not a pose-estimation or behavioural-state classifier.
Age set to 'adult' from abstract ('adult male Wistar rats'); sex n_male = 30 behavioural subjects (modal; 14 additional males used only for IHC).
Outcome dose_dependent set to 'no' for null assays (two doses tested, no modulation), 'yes' for EPM (effect only at 0.075 mg/kg).
group_housing = yes (pairs); note experimental rats were single-housed for 4 days before the SIT.
